strategy_evolution.json.note: Research-only: does not alter live entries. 10-fold chronological walk-forward validation; final untouched 20% holdout gate requires >=30 trades, positive net expectancy after 20 bps costs, PF > 1.05.

strategy_discovery_lab.json.note: Research only. No live signal, model, entry, exit, risk, or portfolio setting is modified.

autonomous_strategy_report.json.note: Research-only. Validation uses chronological train/tune blocks; holdout is observational and never used for ranking or breeding. No live strategy/model changes.

strategy_meta_selector_report.json.note: Independent shadow paper portfolio only. Selection is not connected to live signals or the production model.
